note: Alternate Advancement is here: kills now also feed a separate AA pool — 20 even-match kills earn one AA point, weaker kills pay less, stronger pay more, trivial kills pay nothing. Spend points in the Skills panel on ranked abilities: Toughness, Heavy Blows, Deadeye, and Strong Back, each up to rank 5. Total spend earns display titles, from Wanderer up to Legend of the Wilds. Normal XP and levels are untouched, and there is no level cap to reach first — AA runs alongside levels from the start.
